name: sdkman
label: SDKMAN
description: Java, Maven, Gradle and Kotlin versions from .sdkmanrc.

tools.name: java
list: export sdkman_auto_answer=true; . "${SDKMAN_DIR:-$HOME/.sdkman}/bin/sdkman-init.sh" && sdk list "$1" </dev/null | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | awk -F'|' 'NF>=6 {v=$NF; gsub(/[ \t]/,"",v); if (v!="" && v!="Identifier") print v; next} {n=split($0,a,/[ \t*>+]+/); for(i=1;i<=n;i++) if (a[i] ~ /^[0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$/) print a[i]}' | awk '!s[$0]++'
